patthana8.37:1.1: na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cittavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasampayuttakā khandhā.
patthana8.37:2.1: paccanīyadukamattāni navattabbaṃ dhammaṃ pūretuṃ navanavapañhāni karotu.
